product_overview: LenTrust is a mobile-first peer-to-peer lending accountability app that enables users to lend and borrow money with confidence through digital contracts, automated repayment reminders, and a Trust Score system based on repayment history.
core_goals: Enable borrowers to create loan contracts with clear terms and send them to lenders.
Allow lenders to review loan requests, approve or reject, and track repayments.
Provide automatic reminders and repayment proof upload to maintain accountability.
Calculate and display a Reliability Stars Trust Score to reflect borrower repayment behavior.
Limit extensions and enforce contract lifecycle statuses to ensure clear progress tracking.
Maintain privacy by displaying Reliability Scores only in lender contexts.
Ensure data persistence locally via LocalStorage for offline-ready experience.
key_features: SPA routing across login, dashboard, contracts, create contract, contract detail, profile, search, and error pages.
Borrower flow: create contract, view active/due contracts, request up to 3 time extensions, upload repayment proof to settle.
Lender flow: view loan requests with borrower reviews and reliability stars, accept/reject/counter offers, approve extensions and settlements, post reviews.
Reliability Stars system calculated from repayment history and pinned negative reviews visible to lenders only.
Contract status lifecycle management from REQUESTED to SETTLED with validation rules.
Dialogs for extension requests, proof uploads, and proof viewing.
Dashboard overview with active metrics, loan and extension requests, actions, borrower/lender sections.
Search and profile pages to view user stats and reviews.
Invite friends via multi-platform share dialog with copying link.
Mobile-first UI using TailwindCSS, React, and state management with Zustand.
user_flow_summary: Borrower creates a contract by inputting loan amount (>= Rs.100), due date/time (48hrs to 90 days), lender phone (+91 format), and optional reason; contract saved with REQUESTED status.
Borrower views active and due contracts, can request up to 3 extensions with new due date/time and reason.
Borrower uploads repayment proof to mark contract as SETTLE_PENDING.
Lender reviews incoming loan requests with borrower Reliability Stars and pinned negative reviews, then accepts, rejects, or counters offers.
Lender approves or denies extension requests and settlement proof uploads.
After settlement or final extension expiry, lender posts a review; negative reviews pin until resolved by repayment.
Reliability Stars update dynamically from 12-month repayment performance.
System enforces one active request per borrower-lender pair and validates amounts, dates, and phone formats.
validation_criteria: Loan amount must be at least Rs.100.
Due date must be between 48 hours and 90 days from contract creation.
Lender phone number must adhere to +91 format.
No more than one active loan request allowed per borrower-lender pair simultaneously.
Extensions capped at a maximum of three per contract; display final extension banner thereafter.
Reliability Stars and pinned negative reviews must be visible only to lenders during loan request review.
Contracts must advance correctly through lifecycle statuses: REQUESTED, ACTIVE, DUE, SETTLE_PENDING, SETTLED, REJECTED.
Borrower’s repayment proof upload and lender’s approval flow must be correctly implemented and tested.
Seed demo data must reflect contract states and reliability scores accurately for QA verifications.
